note: Text is copied from the owner's scans. 'countsAsGlyph' marks Treasures that count as a card of that glyph in each of your spells.

cards.name: The Thinking Cap
cards.text: When you gain this Treasure, draw a card. Your hand size is increased by one.

cards.name: The Wood Lord's Clogs
cards.text: This Treasure counts as a Primal card in each of your spells.

cards.name: Kingor the Sharp Seer's Crown
cards.text: Your Power Rolls have +1 for each different glyph in your spell.

cards.name: The Phister Cannon
cards.text: Add a die to each Power Roll you make for a Delivery card.

cards.name: The Double Downer
cards.text: When a foe plays a card with the same name as a card in your hand, you may discard that card. If you do, deal 2 damage to that player, and you heal 2 HP.

cards.name: The "Let's End This!" Shit
cards.text: Add 2 to your Power Rolls for each dead Wizard.

cards.name: Skullzor Ring of Power
cards.text: Add two dice to each Power Roll you make for a Quality card.

cards.name: Slow Roller's Throne
cards.text: When you are the last Wizard to act in a round, add a die to each of your Power Rolls.

cards.name: Methy-Ion's Backpack of Speed
cards.text: Your spells have +10 Initiative. You may discard this Treasure to act last in a round.

cards.name: Lady Luck's Panties
cards.text: Whenever you roll only one die, add 2 to your roll.

cards.name: Cheater's Handbook
cards.text: When you make a Power Roll, you may reroll one die.

cards.name: The Joker's Wild Codpiece
cards.text: When you play a spell that contains one or more Wild Magic cards, heal 2 HP and gain a Treasure.

cards.name: Lady Luck's Garters
cards.text: When you reveal a spell, if you played two or fewer cards, add a random card from your hand to your spell.

cards.name: Crown of the Meek
cards.text: Each Dark card cast by a foe deals 1 damage to that foe before the card's effect resolves.

cards.name: Proton Gem
cards.text: You may add this card to your spell face up. It counts as a Wild Magic card but is not discarded.

cards.name: Plink Cannon
cards.text: At the start of your turn, deal 1 damage to the Wizard on your left.

cards.name: Fool's Gold
cards.text: You heal 2 HP whenever a foe's Power Roll result is 4 or less.

cards.name: The Moccasins of Mana
cards.text: This Treasure counts as an Arcane card in each of your spells.

cards.name: Desperation Stones
cards.text: If you have 9 or fewer HP, add a die to each of your Power Rolls.

cards.name: Amulet of Maneg
cards.text: When you make a Power Roll, heal 1 HP for each natural 6 you roll.

cards.name: The Pumps of Power
cards.text: This Treasure counts as an Elemental card in each of your spells.

cards.name: The Demon Shoes!
cards.text: This Treasure counts as a Dark card in each of your Spells.

cards.name: Big Book of Awesomeness
cards.text: Your Power Rolls have +2.

cards.name: The Trickster's Boots
cards.text: This Treasure counts as an Illusion card in each of your spells.

cards.name: Lady Luck's Brassiere
cards.text: Discard this Treasure to reroll one of your Power Rolls. Then, gain a Treasure.
